_comment: Single source of truth for the doc type frontmatter enum and doc-author agent routing. Edit this file to add, rename, or document doc types. check_doc_frontmatter.py reads this file at startup; architect-review.md and business-analyst.md are regenerated by build.py when this file changes. Legacy hyphenated aliases (how-to, cross-cutting) are kept as deprecated entries for backward compatibility with existing docs. default_path values use {paths.X.Y} placeholders resolved by path_resolver.expand_placeholders() at build time.

how_to.description: Task-oriented procedure: 'how do I do X?' Step-by-step, narrow scope.

reference.description: Lookup-oriented: API tables, schema dictionaries, configuration enums. Comprehensive and dry.

explanation.description: Understanding-oriented: 'why does X work this way?' Discusses context, tradeoffs, history.

tutorial.description: Learning-oriented: hand-holds a beginner through a contained skill. Rare in this project.

adr.description: Architecture Decision Record: captures a decision, its context, alternatives, consequences.

architecture.description: Descriptive architecture doc: system design, component diagram, data flow doc with mermaid.

retro.description: Retrospective: post-epic learnings, blocker patterns, rule changes proposed.

how-to.description: Legacy alias for how_to. Use how_to in new docs.

cross-cutting.description: Cross-cutting concern: spans multiple layers or components. Use explanation for new cross-cutting docs.
